content:
[Intro]
[Esus2]
[B]
[Esus2]
[B]

[Verse 1]
[Esus2]I'm going to ride this plane
[B]out of your life again.
[Esus2]I wish that I could stay
[B]but you argue.
[Esus2]More than this I wish
[B]you could've seen my face
[Esus2]In backseat staring out
[B]the window.

[Pre-Chorus]
[Esus2]I'll do anything for
[B]you,
[Esus2]Kill anyone for
[B]you.
[Esus2]So leave yourself intact
[B]'Cause I will be coming back.
[Esus2]In a phrase to cut these lips,
[B]I love you.

[Chorus]
[B]The morning will come
[Esus2]In the press
[C#m]of every kiss With your head
[Emaj7]upon my chest
[B]Where I will annoy
[Esus2]you With eve-
[C#m]ry waking breath Until you
[Emaj7]decide to wake up.

[Verse 2]
[Esus2]I've earned through hope and faith
[B]The curves around your face
[Esus2]That I'm the one you'll hold
[B]forever.
[Esus2]If morning never comes
[B]for either one of us,
[Esus2]Then this I pray to you
[B]wherever.

[Pre-Chorus]
[Esus2]I'll do anything for
[B]you.
[Esus2]This story is for
[B]you. ('Cause
[Esus2]I'd i'd do do any thing for
[B]you anything you want me to... for you.)
[Esus2]Kill anyone for
[B]you.
[Esus2]So leave yourself intact
[B]'Cause I will be coming back.
[Esus2]In a phrase to cut these lips,
[B]I love you.

[Chorus]
[B]The morning will come
[Esus2]In the press
[C#m]of every kiss With your head
[Emaj7]upon my chest
[B]Where I will annoy
[Esus2]you With eve-
[C#m]ry waking breath Until you
[Emaj7]decide to wake up.

[Outro]
[B]The morning will come
[Esus2]In the press
[C#m]of every kiss With your head
[Emaj7]upon my chest Where
[B]I will annoy
[Esus2]you With eve-
[C#m]ry waking breath 'Til you
[Emaj7]decide to wake up.
title: Wake Up
